status: M0 requirements; not executed daemon regressions

scenarios.setup: A version-specific adapter mapping receives synthetic content/credential canaries, including deliberately contaminated identifier/version strings; a fixture writer dies after creating a temporary file before atomic rename.
scenarios.operation: Run restart, privacy disable and bounded owned cleanup.
scenarios.expected: Only allowlisted metadata with verified source-field provenance/mapping is eligible for persistence; canary-bearing mappings are rejected or omitted before writes; no owned orphan survives its retention contract; unrelated files remain.
scenarios.invariant: Field-level minimization applies to temporaries and recovery; string schemas alone do not prove secrecy.
scenarios.verification: Version-specific adapter provenance/mapping review and canary tests before enabling persistence; actual cross-process kill points and spool/temp/database/WAL/log/recovery-output canary audits in a disposable filesystem.

scenarios.setup: Content collection is disabled with a fixed policy revision.
scenarios.operation: Request status/diagnostics repeatedly while an observer forwards a turn.
scenarios.expected: Policy revision and collection setting unchanged; diagnostics contain no content.
scenarios.verification: Read-only projection regression test plus state/log canary scan.

scenarios.setup: One working turn and stable process identity under an active filesystem watcher.
scenarios.operation: Run unchanged-active workload across health intervals.
scenarios.expected: No self-triggered chmod/write/watch feedback loop; elapsed labels do not write state.
scenarios.invariant: No work without a bounded external event or scheduled health check.
scenarios.verification: Instrument filesystem events, snapshots, writes, CPU ticks and wakeups.

scenarios.setup: A terminal fact for turn T has committed.
scenarios.operation: Deliver delayed turn.started for T with a later sequence before and after tombstone age/cap eviction, generation retirement and restart; attempt fresh-generation observation with missing or verified reconciliation.
scenarios.expected: T is never revived by a delayed start; eviction atomically retires its generation; old-generation events are rejected, not retagged; missing reconciliation stays stale/unknown; verified current work or a genuinely new turn may run.
scenarios.invariant: Terminal tombstones beat delayed starts; bounded eviction cannot reopen an old generation or bypass reconciliation.
scenarios.verification: Permutation/property tests across lifecycle order, age/cap boundaries, retirement/eviction crash points, old-spool replay and unavailable/successful current-turn reconciliation.

scenarios.setup: Unreviewed completion has eligible pending delivery and history is at retention limit.
scenarios.expected: Delivery intent and unread outcome remain or explicit overflow/expiry is visible; not silently lost.
scenarios.invariant: History retention is independent of outbox and human review.
scenarios.verification: Transaction/crash regression with send/ack ambiguity cases.

scenarios.setup: Recorded owned PID still exists but Linux state is zombie.
scenarios.operation: Reconcile liveness and attempt attach/end against boot/start identity.
scenarios.expected: Not shown as a functioning running agent; no blind PID-only control; resume needs prior runtime reconciliation.
scenarios.invariant: Existence is not liveness or ownership.
scenarios.verification: Real fork/unreaped-child fixture and PID identity negative cases.

scenarios.setup: Adapter exposes output verbosity but no reasoning-effort signal.
scenarios.expected: Reasoning effort remains unknown; verbosity is labeled separately.
scenarios.invariant: One metric never substitutes for another.

scenarios.setup: Registered producer and known state revision.
scenarios.operation: Send unknown version, oversized/deep JSON, duplicate keys or invalid identifiers.
scenarios.expected: Reject with bounded machine error and no domain mutation; capability degrades truthfully.
scenarios.invariant: Parsing and authorization precede durable state changes.
scenarios.verification: Framing/parser fuzz and strict-schema negative cases.

scenarios.setup: Launch request accepted but client loses connection before seeing result.
scenarios.operation: Retry identical request; then retry same ID with changed intent.
scenarios.expected: Existing launch is reconciled once; conflicting intent is rejected.
scenarios.invariant: Idempotency is durable and not a UI-only debounce.
scenarios.verification: Crash before spawn/after spawn/before acknowledgment with runner enumeration.

scenarios.setup: Desktop accepted notification but process crashes before recording acknowledgment.
scenarios.operation: Recover outbox and retry according to policy.
scenarios.expected: Outcome remains unread; duplicate display may occur and uncertainty is explicit.
scenarios.verification: Real fake-notification-service test fixture labeled as a test, not desktop evidence.

scenarios.setup: Stored process/window identifier is stale, reused or unrelated.
scenarios.expected: Refuse unproven target, preserve unrelated windows/processes.
scenarios.invariant: Identity and ownership are rechecked at action time.
scenarios.verification: Disposable window and process identity tests; no private real-window titles.

scenarios.setup: Two bridges subscribe, one stops reading while event stream continues.
scenarios.operation: Fill slow consumer queue past the specified limit.
scenarios.expected: Bound memory, disconnect/resnapshot the slow stream, preserve responsive stream and expose loss/gap.
scenarios.invariant: A slow UI cannot block the daemon or other clients.
scenarios.verification: Socket backpressure integration fixture with measured queue sizes.

scenarios.setup: A disposable profile has pre-existing unrelated hooks/settings.
scenarios.operation: Install observer, interrupt installation, recover and uninstall.
scenarios.expected: Unrelated config preserved; owned payload restored/removed; no approval bypass.
scenarios.invariant: Trust and configuration ownership survive partial writes.
scenarios.verification: Installed loader/CLI probes in disposable homes, no credentials.

scenarios.operation: Open project/terminal, then explicitly mark reviewed.
scenarios.expected: Opening does not clear review; explicit action only reviews that outcome revision.
scenarios.invariant: Human acceptance is distinct from native action and delivery.
scenarios.verification: UI state test with newer-outcome race and stale revision.
